steps.title: 建立一个空白零件
steps.command: 文件 File → 新建 New → 零件 Part → 确定 OK
actions: 打开 SOLIDWORKS，按 Ctrl+N；在“新建 SOLIDWORKS 文件”窗口选择“零件 / Part”，点击“确定 / OK”。
在左侧 FeatureManager 设计树找到“前视基准面 / Front Plane”“上视基准面 / Top Plane”“右视基准面 / Right Plane”和“原点 / Origin”。若看不到树，按 F9。
每道题新建一个零件；在第一次保存时按 Ctrl+Shift+S，依次使用 Q1.sldprt 至 Q5.sldprt。
steps.check: 出现空白零件，尚无实体；左侧能选中三个基准面。
steps.fix: 若创建成装配体或工程图，重新执行“新建 → 零件”。

en.title: Create a blank part
actions: Open SOLIDWORKS and press Ctrl+N. In the New SOLIDWORKS Document dialog, select Part and click OK.
In the FeatureManager design tree on the left, locate Front Plane, Top Plane, Right Plane and Origin. If the tree is hidden, press F9.
Create a new part for each question. For its first save, press Ctrl+Shift+S and use the filenames Q1.sldprt through Q5.sldprt.
en.check: A blank part is open with no solid body, and the three reference planes can be selected in the tree.
en.fix: If you created an assembly or drawing, choose New → Part again.

steps.title: 输入尺寸前，先设置单位
steps.command: 右下角单位菜单 → MMGS / IPS
actions: Q1、Q2、Q3、Q5：点击窗口右下角的单位缩写，选“MMGS（毫米、克、秒）”。Q4：选择“IPS（英寸、磅、秒）”。
若没有快捷菜单：工具 / Tools → 选项 / Options → 文档属性 / Document Properties → 单位 / Units，选择对应单位制并点击“确定”。
本教程 Q4 的小数尺寸都带 in；即使使用毫米文档，也可以在输入框直接键入“0.3in”，由软件换算。
steps.check: 右下角单位与本题一致。
steps.fix: Q4 原文写 mm，却给出 in³ 参考体积；本教程依据图形尺寸与体积采用英寸解释，保留这一原文矛盾。

en.title: Set the units before entering dimensions
en.command: Units menu at the bottom right → MMGS / IPS
actions: For Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q5, click the unit abbreviation at the bottom right and select MMGS (millimeter, gram, second). For Q4, select IPS (inch, pound, second).
If the shortcut menu is unavailable, go to Tools → Options → Document Properties → Units, select the required unit system and click OK.
The decimal dimensions in this tutorial's Q4 use in. Even in a millimetre document, you can enter 0.3in directly in a dimension box and let SOLIDWORKS convert it.
en.check: The units shown at the bottom right match the current question.
en.fix: Q4 states mm in the source text but gives a reference volume in in³. This tutorial interprets its lengths as inches based on the drawing and volume, while explicitly retaining that source inconsistency.

steps.title: 认清基准面与本文坐标
steps.command: 视图 View → 隐藏/显示 Hide/Show → 原点 Origins
actions: 为与原网站模型一致，本文用 (u,v,h) 表示“长度、横向/深度、高度”，它们是教学坐标，不是 SOLIDWORKS 全局 XYZ。
对应关系为 SOLIDWORKS (X,Y,Z)=(u,h,−v)。因此 Top Plane 是 h=0，Front Plane 是 v=0，Right Plane 是 u=0。表格中负号表示原点另一侧。
Q2—Q5 的宽度关于 v=0 对称。Q1 的原点在图示底座基准角；Q3 在底板前端底边中点；Q4 在开口尖点所在的上表面。
原题采用第一角投影：俯视图在主视图下方。按视图名称和尺寸线判断方向，不要把页面下方的图当作零件底面。
steps.check: 能在模型原点处辨认长度、深度和高度，且不把教学坐标误填成全局 XYZ。
steps.fix: 草图参数框中的 X/Y 依赖草图方向；后续优先用“智能尺寸”相对原点/边线定位，不要求盲填坐标。

en.title: Identify the reference planes and tutorial coordinates
en.phase: Reading the drawing and locating geometry
actions: To remain consistent with the original website models, this tutorial uses (u,v,h) for length, transverse/depth position and height. These are teaching coordinates, not the SOLIDWORKS global XYZ coordinates.

The mapping is SOLIDWORKS (X,Y,Z)=(u,h,−v). Therefore, Top Plane is h=0, Front Plane is v=0 and Right Plane is u=0. A negative value in a table places the coordinate on the opposite side of the origin.

Q2–Q5 are symmetric across v=0 in the width direction. Q1 uses the indicated reference corner of the base as its origin; Q3 uses the midpoint of the front bottom edge of the base; Q4 uses the upper surface at the inner jaw apex.
The source uses first-angle projection, with the top view below the front view. Determine directions from the view names and dimension lines; the lower view on the page is not the bottom of the part.
en.check: You can identify length, depth and height at the model origin, without entering the teaching coordinates as global XYZ values.
en.fix: The X/Y fields in sketch parameters depend on the sketch orientation. In the following steps, use Smart Dimension relative to the origin or edges to locate geometry, rather than entering coordinates without checking their orientation.

steps.title: 进入草图，画完后退出当前工具
steps.command: 选基准面/平面 → 草图 Sketch → 草图 Sketch → Ctrl+8
actions: 先在树中选一个基准面，或在实体上单击指定的平面，再点击“草图 / Sketch”选项卡的“草图 / Sketch”。按 Ctrl+8 执行“正视于 / Normal To”。
点击“矩形 / Rectangle”“直线 / Line”或“圆 / Circle”作图；先画近似大小，再标准确尺寸。圆的第一下是圆心，第二下决定大小。
画完按 Esc 退出当前画图工具；点击“退出草图 / Exit Sketch”才是结束整张草图。两者不同。
steps.check: 编辑时状态栏显示“编辑草图 / Editing Sketch”；退出后草图作为独立项目出现在树中。
steps.fix: 若选到了圆柱面，它不能作为普通平面草图的草图面；改选平端面或指定基准面。

en.title: Enter a sketch, then leave the active drawing tool
en.command: Select a reference plane or planar face → Sketch tab → Sketch → Ctrl+8
actions: Select a reference plane in the tree, or click the specified planar face on the solid. On the Sketch tab, click Sketch. Press Ctrl+8 for Normal To.
Use Rectangle, Line or Circle to draw an approximate shape, then apply exact dimensions. For a circle, the first click sets its centre and the second sets its size.
Press Esc after drawing to leave the active drawing tool. Click Exit Sketch to finish the entire sketch. These are separate actions.
en.check: While editing, the status bar shows Editing Sketch. After exiting, the sketch appears as a separate item in the tree.
en.fix: A cylindrical face cannot serve as the plane for an ordinary planar sketch. Select a flat end face or the specified reference plane instead.

steps.title: 用智能尺寸精确定位
steps.command: 草图 Sketch → 智能尺寸 Smart Dimension
actions: 标线长：选一条直线，移动鼠标放置尺寸，键入数值并按 Enter。标圆：选圆周，放置 Ø 尺寸。标圆弧：选圆弧，放置 R 尺寸。
标点到原点的水平/竖直距离：先选点，再选原点，向上/下移动鼠标放水平尺寸，向左/右移动放竖直尺寸；输入距离的绝对值，点所在侧决定正负位置。
要约束点在轴线上：按住 Ctrl 选择该点和原点，在“添加几何关系 / Add Relations”中选“水平 / Horizontal”或“竖直 / Vertical”。圆心与原点重合时选“重合 / Coincident”。
每次尺寸输入后点绿色对勾或按 Enter，最后按 Esc 离开尺寸工具。
dimensions: 设为从动 / Driven，仅作检查
steps.check: 尺寸值保持不变，拖动草图不会改变已标注的长度。
steps.fix: 不要同时标一组已由其他尺寸和关系决定的数值；若提示过定义，撤销刚加的重复尺寸。

en.title: Locate geometry precisely with Smart Dimension
actions: For a line length, select a line, move the pointer to place the dimension, enter its value and press Enter. For a circle, select its circumference to place a Ø dimension. For an arc, select the arc to place an R dimension.

For the horizontal or vertical distance from a point to the origin, select the point and then the origin. Move the pointer above or below to place a horizontal dimension, or left or right to place a vertical one. Enter the absolute distance; the side on which the point lies determines its positive or negative position.
To place a point on an axis, Ctrl-select the point and the origin, then choose Horizontal or Vertical under Add Relations. To place a circle centre at the origin, choose Coincident.
After entering each dimension, click the green check mark or press Enter. Finally, press Esc to leave the dimension tool.
dimensions: Make it Driven, for checking only
en.check: Dimension values remain fixed, and dragging the sketch does not change dimensioned lengths.
en.fix: Do not add dimensions that are already determined by other dimensions and relations. If the sketch becomes over defined, undo the redundant dimension you just added.

steps.title: 确认草图完全定义
steps.command: 工具 Tools → 尺寸标注 Dimensions → 完全定义草图 Fully Define Sketch
actions: 先用本教程给出的尺寸和重合、水平、竖直、相切、对称等关系约束草图。每次退出前查看状态栏“完全定义 / Fully Defined”。
默认颜色下，完全约束的普通草图线为黑色，仍有自由度的线为蓝色。若整幅图能平移，通常缺少与原点或已知边线的位置关系。
若修剪后尺寸或关系丢失，重新补齐。可从“工具 → 尺寸标注 → 完全定义草图”检查并补充，但先确认自动产生的尺寸是否符合题意。
不要用“固定 / Fix”把随手画出的形状锁住来代替准确尺寸。
steps.check: 状态栏明确显示“完全定义”，无红色/黄色冲突提示。
steps.fix: 放大检查未合并的端点：Ctrl 选两个端点 → 重合。缺口会阻止实体拉伸。

en.title: Confirm that the sketch is fully defined
actions: First constrain the sketch using the tutorial dimensions and relations such as Coincident, Horizontal, Vertical, Tangent and Symmetric. Before exiting each sketch, check that the status bar reads Fully Defined.

With the default colours, fully constrained ordinary sketch entities are black, while entities with remaining degrees of freedom are blue. If the entire sketch can translate, it usually lacks a position relation to the origin or a known edge.

Restore any dimensions or relations lost during trimming. You can use Tools → Dimensions → Fully Define Sketch to check and add constraints, but first confirm that any automatically generated dimensions agree with the intended design.
Do not use Fix to lock an approximately drawn shape in place of applying accurate dimensions.
en.check: The status bar explicitly reads Fully Defined, with no red or yellow conflict indications.
en.fix: Zoom in to check for separate endpoints. Ctrl-select the two endpoints and choose Coincident. A gap can prevent solid extrusion.

steps.title: 设置拉伸、切除与结束条件
steps.command: 特征 Features → 拉伸凸台/基体 Extruded Boss/Base / 拉伸切除 Extruded Cut
actions: 完成并退出草图后选中它，点击“特征 / Features → 拉伸凸台/基体 / Extruded Boss/Base”，或“拉伸切除 / Extruded Cut”。
“给定深度 / Blind”输入本次增加或切除的长度；“中面 / Mid Plane”输入两侧合计的总厚度；“贯穿全部 / Through All”切穿该方向上的全部实体。
看黄色预览与方向箭头。方向相反时点击“反向 / Reverse Direction”；需要穿过草图两侧时选“完全贯穿-两者 / Through All - Both”（部分版本称双向贯穿）。
新增凸台与原实体接触时保留“合并结果 / Merge result”，点击绿色对勾。树中的“实体 / Solid Bodies”应只有 1 个。
dimensions: 孔后方的其他实体也会被切穿
steps.check: 预览方向正确，确认后特征没有红叉。
steps.fix: 重建失败时先检查草图是否闭合、凸台是否与主体接触、切除方向是否穿过实体。

en.title: Set extrusions, cuts and end conditions
actions: Finish and exit the sketch, select it, and click Features → Extruded Boss/Base or Extruded Cut.
For Blind, enter the length added or removed in this feature. For Mid Plane, enter the total thickness across both sides. Through All cuts through all solid material in the selected direction.

Inspect the yellow preview and direction arrow. Click Reverse Direction if it points the wrong way. To cut through both sides of the sketch plane, choose Through All - Both; some versions label this as a bidirectional through-all cut.
When a new boss touches the existing solid, keep Merge result selected and click the green check mark. Solid Bodies in the tree should contain only 1 body.
dimensions: Also cuts through other solid material behind the hole
en.check: The preview points in the correct direction, and the completed feature has no red error mark.
en.fix: If rebuilding fails, first check whether the sketch is closed, whether the boss touches the main body and whether the cut direction intersects the solid.

steps.title: 核对体积，并保留可编辑特征
steps.command: 评估 Evaluate → 质量属性 Mass Properties
actions: 完成每题后按 Ctrl+Q 强制重建，再点击“评估 / Evaluate → 质量属性 / Mass Properties”；也可从“工具 → 评估”进入。
读取“体积 / Volume”。Q1—Q3 用 mm³，Q4 用 in³；若报告单位不同，点击报告中的“选项 / Options”调整输出单位。
按 Ctrl+S 保存为 SOLIDWORKS 零件（*.sldprt）。右键某个草图选“编辑草图 / Edit Sketch”，右键某个特征选“编辑特征 / Edit Feature”，即可修改。
steps.check: 文件扩展名为 .sldprt，设计树中有自己建立的草图和特征。
steps.fix: STEP 只提供导入的几何参考，不包含原始拉伸、切除和草图历史；本教程从空白零件手动创建。

en.title: Check the volume and retain editable features
actions: After finishing each question, press Ctrl+Q to force a rebuild, then click Evaluate → Mass Properties. You can also access it through Tools → Evaluate.
Read Volume. Use mm³ for Q1–Q3 and in³ for Q4. If the report uses different units, click Options in the report to change the output units.
Press Ctrl+S to save as a SOLIDWORKS part (*.sldprt). To modify it, right-click a sketch and choose Edit Sketch, or right-click a feature and choose Edit Feature.
en.check: The file extension is .sldprt, and the design tree contains the sketches and features you created.
en.fix: STEP supplies imported reference geometry without the original extrusion, cut or sketch history. This tutorial builds the part manually from a blank document.

steps.title: 新建 Q1，设置毫米
steps.command: Ctrl+N → Part；单位 MMGS；Ctrl+Shift+S
actions: 新建零件，设置 MMGS，保存为 Q1.sldprt。
本题不要求 Front Plane 是对称面。以原图红点对应的底座角为原点，底座从 u=0 到 60、v=0 到 28、高度从 h=0 向上。
本题每个凸台只画一个简单矩形，孔单独用圆草图。
dimensions: 总长 / 总深 / 总高
steps.check: 空白零件已保存，单位为 mm。
steps.fix: 不要把各级台阶一次画成复杂阶梯轮廓。

en.title: Create Q1 and set millimetres
actions: Create a new part, select MMGS and save it as Q1.sldprt.

This question does not require Front Plane to be a symmetry plane. Use the base corner corresponding to the red point in the original drawing as the origin. The base extends from u=0 to 60, from v=0 to 28 and upward from h=0.
Use one simple rectangle for each boss and a separate circular sketch for the hole.
en.check: The blank part is saved and its length unit is mm.
en.fix: Do not draw all the steps as one complex stepped profile.

steps.title: 在 Top Plane 画底座矩形
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → 角点矩形 Corner Rectangle
actions: 选 Top Plane → 草图 → Ctrl+8。选择“矩形”下拉菜单中的“角点矩形 / Corner Rectangle”。
第一下单击原点，第二下在零件的长度与深度正向放置另一角；按 Esc。
智能尺寸：长边 60、深度边 28。确认原点角有“重合”，四边有水平/竖直关系，草图完全定义。
steps.check: 一个完全定义的矩形，基准角与原点重合。
steps.fix: 深度 28 是底座总深，不是上层台阶的 20。

en.title: Sketch the base rectangle on Top Plane
actions: Select Top Plane → Sketch → Ctrl+8. From the Rectangle drop-down menu, choose Corner Rectangle.
Click the origin for the first corner. Place the other corner in the positive length and depth directions of the part, then press Esc.

Use Smart Dimension to set the long side to 60 and the depth side to 28. Confirm a Coincident relation at the origin corner, Horizontal/Vertical relations on the four sides and a Fully Defined sketch.
en.check: There is one fully defined rectangle whose reference corner is coincident with the origin.
en.fix: 28 is the full base depth; the upper steps have a depth of 20.

steps.title: 拉伸底座 30 mm
steps.command: 退出草图 → Features → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind
actions: 退出草图，选择刚才的矩形草图，点击“拉伸凸台/基体”。
结束条件选择“给定深度 / Blind”，输入 30；预览从 Top Plane 向上达到 h=30。
点击绿色对勾；可将特征重命名为“底座_60x28x30”。
steps.check: 得到 60 × 28 × 30 mm 的长方体。
steps.fix: 输入的是底座高度 30，不是总高 75。

en.title: Extrude the base by 30 mm
en.command: Exit Sketch → Features → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind
actions: Exit the sketch, select the rectangle sketch you just created and click Extruded Boss/Base.
Select Blind as the end condition and enter 30. The preview should extend upward from Top Plane to h=30.
Click the green check mark. You may rename the feature Base_60x28x30.
en.check: The result is a 60 × 28 × 30 mm rectangular block.
en.fix: Enter the base height of 30, not the overall part height of 75.

steps.title: 在底座顶面画 48 × 20
steps.command: 选 h=30 顶面 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: 单击底座顶面 → 草图 → Ctrl+8。
矩形第一角选与原点同一侧的顶面基准角 (u,v)=(0,0)，另一角放在 (48,20) 一侧。
智能尺寸设长 48、深 20；第一角与该顶点重合，确认完全定义。
steps.check: 台阶右端距底座右端 12，深度方向余量为 28−20=8。
steps.fix: 每层都从相同的 u=0、v=0 基准角出发。

en.title: Sketch 48 × 20 on the top of the base
en.command: Select the top face at h=30 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: Click the top face of the base → Sketch → Ctrl+8.
Place the first rectangle corner at the reference corner of the top face on the origin side, (u,v)=(0,0). Place the other corner toward (48,20).
Use Smart Dimension to set length 48 and depth 20. Make the first corner coincident with that vertex and confirm that the sketch is fully defined.
dimensions: The same reference corner at u=0, v=0
en.check: The step ends 12 short of the right end of the base, leaving 28−20=8 in the depth direction.
en.fix: Start every layer at the same reference corner, u=0 and v=0.

steps.title: 追加拉伸 8 mm
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 8 → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体，深度输入 8，向上拉伸。
保留“合并结果”，点击绿色对勾。
8 来自两级顶面高差：20−12；因此该层顶面高度为 30+8=38。
steps.check: 顶面到达 38，树中仍只有一个实体。
steps.fix: 图上的 20 是底座顶面到第二级顶面的累计高度。

en.title: Add an 8 mm extrusion
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Enter depth 8 and extrude upward.
Keep Merge result selected and click the green check mark.
8 is derived from the difference between the two step-top levels: 20−12. The resulting top-face height is therefore 30+8=38.
en.check: The top face reaches 38, and the tree still contains only one solid body.
en.fix: The 20 shown in the drawing is the cumulative height from the top of the base to the top of the second step.

steps.title: 画 32 × 20 的第二层
steps.command: 选 h=38 顶面 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: 选刚生成的 48 × 20 台阶顶面 → 新建草图 → Ctrl+8。
从同一基准角画矩形，用智能尺寸设长 32、深 20。
32=20+12；第一角与该顶点重合。确认矩形完全定义。
steps.check: 在上一层顶面上出现一个宽度更小、深度相同的矩形。
steps.fix: 中间另一个台阶的露出长度为 48−32=16，是推导值。

en.title: Sketch the second layer, 32 × 20
en.command: Select the top face at h=38 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: Select the newly created 48 × 20 top face → New Sketch → Ctrl+8.
Draw a rectangle from the same reference corner and use Smart Dimension to set length 32 and depth 20.
32=20+12. Make the first corner coincident with that vertex and confirm that the rectangle is fully defined.
en.check: A shorter rectangle of the same depth lies on the preceding top face.
en.fix: The other exposed intermediate platform length is the derived value 48−32=16.

steps.title: 追加拉伸 12 mm
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 12
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。给定深度 12，方向向上，合并结果。
点击绿色对勾。该层顶面应为 h=38+12=50。
steps.check: 底座顶面到此顶面为 20 mm。
steps.fix: 不要把累计 20 输入成本次拉伸量。

en.title: Add a 12 mm extrusion
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Set Blind depth 12, point upward and select Merge result.
Click the green check mark. This layer's top face should be at h=38+12=50.
en.check: This top face is 20 mm above the top face of the base.
en.fix: Do not enter the cumulative height of 20 as this extrusion's depth.

steps.title: 画最高层的 20 × 20
steps.command: 选 h=50 顶面 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: 选 32 × 20 顶面，进入草图并按 Ctrl+8。
从相同基准角 (0,0) 画矩形，用智能尺寸设 20 × 20。
确认重合与水平/竖直关系齐全，草图完全定义。
steps.check: 高台沿 u 方向长度为 20，和下面台阶同深。
steps.fix: 不要把两条 20 都理解为高度。

en.title: Sketch the highest layer, 20 × 20
en.command: Select the top face at h=50 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: Select the 32 × 20 top face, enter a sketch and press Ctrl+8.
Draw a rectangle from the same reference corner (0,0), then use Smart Dimension to set 20 × 20.
Confirm the Coincident and Horizontal/Vertical relations and a Fully Defined sketch.
en.check: The tall step has length 20 along u and the same depth as the step below it.
en.fix: The two dimensions of 20 are not both heights.

steps.title: 拉伸 25，达到总高 75
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 25
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体，输入 25=75−50。
向上拉伸，合并结果，点击绿色对勾。
steps.check: 从最低底面到最高顶面测得 75。
steps.fix: 75 是最终总高，不能在 h=50 的顶面再追加 75。

en.title: Extrude 25 to reach an overall height of 75
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base and enter 25=75−50.
Extrude upward, select Merge result and click the green check mark.
en.check: The distance from the lowest bottom face to the highest top face is 75.
en.fix: 75 is the final overall height. On the face at h=50, do not add another 75.

steps.title: 在底座立面画 Ø12 孔
steps.command: 选与 Front Plane 平行的底座立面 → Sketch → Circle
actions: 选择底座的大立面（60 × 30，与 Front Plane 平行），不要选台阶顶面。进入草图，Ctrl+8。
画一个圆，按 Esc；智能尺寸选圆周，输入直径 12。
选圆心和底座右侧竖边，标水平距离 16；选圆心和底边，标竖直距离 16。圆心因此为 u=44、h=16。
steps.check: 圆完全定义，孔心靠底座右端。
steps.fix: 必须标圆心到边的距离，不能选圆周到边的最近距离。

en.title: Sketch the Ø12 hole on the vertical base face
en.command: Select a vertical base face parallel to Front Plane → Sketch → Circle
actions: Select the large vertical face of the base, 60 × 30 and parallel to Front Plane. Do not select a step's top face. Enter a sketch and press Ctrl+8.
Draw a circle and press Esc. Select its circumference with Smart Dimension and enter diameter 12.

Select the circle centre and the right vertical edge of the base to set a horizontal distance of 16. Select the centre and the bottom edge to set a vertical distance of 16. The centre is therefore at u=44, h=16.
dimensions: Distance from right edge / bottom face
en.check: The circle is fully defined, with its centre near the right end of the base.
en.fix: Dimension from the circle centre to the edge, not the shortest distance from the circumference to the edge.

steps.title: 切穿底座全部深度
steps.command: 退出草图 → Extruded Cut → Through All
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除；结束条件选“贯穿全部 / Through All”。
查看预览箭头朝向实体内部；若圆画在 Front Plane 上，也可选“贯穿全部-两者”。
点击绿色对勾，旋转模型，确认前后都有圆孔出口。
steps.check: 孔贯穿整个底座；没有盲孔底面。
steps.fix: 只切 20 会在底座深度方向留下 8 mm 材料。

en.title: Cut through the full depth of the base
en.command: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut, then select Through All as the end condition.
Check that the preview arrow points into the solid. If the circle was sketched on Front Plane, you may also choose Through All - Both.
Click the green check mark, rotate the model and confirm that the circular hole exits at both the front and back.
en.check: The hole passes through the whole base and has no blind-hole bottom face.
en.fix: A cut depth of only 20 would leave 8 mm of material along the base depth.

steps.title: 重建、核对体积并保存
steps.command: Ctrl+Q → Evaluate → Mass Properties → Ctrl+S
actions: 质量属性中查看体积，目标 72593 mm³ ±1%；本教程几何为 72593.2746 mm³。
设计树应有 4 个拉伸凸台、1 个拉伸切除。每张草图完全定义后保存 Q1.sldprt。
steps.check: 总高、孔位置和体积同时满足。
steps.fix: 体积接近不能替代位置检查；错放原点或把台阶放在另一侧仍需修正。

en.title: Rebuild, check the volume and save
actions: Check the 60 × 28 × 30 base, step-top heights h=38/50/75, Ø12 hole and both dimensions of 16.
Read the volume in Mass Properties. The target is 72593 mm³ ±1%; the tutorial geometry has a volume of 72593.2746 mm³.
The design tree should contain 4 boss extrusions and 1 extruded cut. Fully define every sketch and save Q1.sldprt.
en.check: The overall height, hole position and volume all meet the requirements.
en.fix: A close volume cannot replace checking positions. An incorrectly located origin or steps placed on the wrong side still need correction.

steps.title: 新建 Q2，确定对称面
steps.command: Ctrl+N → Part → MMGS → 保存 Q2.sldprt
actions: 新建零件，单位 MMGS，保存 Q2.sldprt。
以大端中心下方、连接板底面的红点为原点。Top Plane 是连接板底面 h=0；两端圆心都在 Front Plane（v=0）内。
steps.check: 后续两个圆心沿 u 方向相隔 38。
steps.fix: Front Plane 是纵向对称面；不要把整块零件的平面轮廓画在 Front Plane 上。

en.title: Create Q2 and establish the symmetry plane
actions: Create a new part, set the units to MMGS, and save it as Q2.sldprt.
Use the red point on the bottom of the link plate, directly below the large-end center, as the origin. Top Plane is the plate bottom at h=0; both end centers lie in Front Plane (v=0).
en.check: The two end centers will be 38 apart along u.
en.fix: Front Plane is the longitudinal symmetry plane. Do not sketch the part's entire flat outline on Front Plane.

steps.title: 在 Top Plane 定位两个外圆
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Circle → Smart Dimension
actions: 选 Top Plane → 草图 → Ctrl+8。在原点画大圆，直径设 32。
在大圆右侧画小圆，直径设 18（R9）。Ctrl 选两个圆心 → 添加“水平”关系。
智能尺寸选择两个圆心，标水平中心距 38。大圆心与原点重合；两个圆都应完全定义。
steps.check: 圆心同高，大圆在原点，小圆沿长度正向。
steps.fix: 标注的径向“6”是大端壁厚；大外圆不是 Ø26。

en.title: Locate the two outer circles on Top Plane
en.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Circle → Smart Dimension
actions: Select Top Plane → Sketch → Ctrl+8. Draw the large circle at the origin and set its diameter to 32.
Draw the small circle to the right of the large one and set its diameter to 18 (R9). Ctrl-select the two centers and add a Horizontal relation.
Use Smart Dimension on the two centers to set the horizontal center distance to 38. Make the large center Coincident with the origin; both circles should be fully defined.
en.check: The centers are at the same level, with the large center at the origin and the small center in the positive length direction.
en.fix: The radial dimension 6 is the large-end wall thickness. The large outer circle is not Ø26.

steps.title: 画上下两条公外切线
steps.command: Line → Ctrl 选直线与圆 → Add Relations → Tangent
actions: 选“直线”，画连接两个圆上侧的线段，再画连接下侧的线段，按 Esc。每条线的两个端点分别落在两圆周上。
若未自动捕捉相切：Ctrl 选上直线和大圆 → 相切 / Tangent；再选同一线和小圆 → 相切。下直线也分别与两个圆添加相切。
确认四个端点与各自圆周都有“重合 / Coincident”，两直线都变黑。
dimensions: 两条线 × 两端相切，共 4 个相切关系
steps.check: 两条线斜向收窄，不是水平平行线。
steps.fix: 不能连接圆的最高点来代替公外切线；圆半径不同，切点不在正上/正下方。

en.title: Draw the upper and lower common external tangents
en.command: Line → Ctrl-select a line and circle → Add Relations → Tangent
actions: Select Line. Draw one segment connecting the upper sides of the two circles and another connecting the lower sides, then press Esc. Each segment has one endpoint on each circle.

If tangency was not inferred automatically, Ctrl-select the upper line and the large circle → Tangent; then select the same line and the small circle → Tangent. Add the corresponding Tangent relations between the lower line and both circles.
Check that all four endpoints have Coincident relations to their respective circles and that both lines turn black.
dimensions: Two lines × tangency at both ends, giving 4 Tangent relations
en.check: The two lines slope inward toward the smaller end; they are not horizontal parallel lines.
en.fix: Do not substitute lines joining the circles' highest points for the common external tangents. With different radii, the tangent points are not directly above or below the centers.

steps.title: 修剪内侧圆弧，留下闭合外轮廓
steps.command: Sketch → 修剪实体 Trim Entities → 智能剪裁 Power Trim
actions: 点击“修剪实体”，删去大圆朝向小圆的内侧短圆弧，以及小圆朝向大圆的内侧圆弧。
保留大端外侧长圆弧、小端外侧圆弧和两条切线，使外轮廓只有一个闭合环；按 Esc。
修剪可能移除尺寸或几何关系。检查圆弧 R16、R9，弧心 (0,0)、(38,0) 及相切关系，必要时重新添加，直到完全定义。
steps.check: 启用“上色的草图轮廓 / Shaded Sketch Contours”时，整个连接板区域连续着色。
steps.fix: 删错圆弧按 Ctrl+Z；不要留下内部圆弧把区域分割成多个未说明的轮廓。

en.title: Trim the inner arcs to leave one closed outer contour
actions: Click Trim Entities. Remove the short inner arc of the large circle facing the small circle, and the inner arc of the small circle facing the large circle.
Keep the long outer arc at the large end, the outer arc at the small end, and the two tangent lines, leaving a single closed outer loop. Press Esc.
Trimming can remove dimensions or relations. Check arc radii R16 and R9, centers (0,0) and (38,0), and the Tangent relations. Restore any missing constraints until the sketch is fully defined.
en.check: With Shaded Sketch Contours enabled, the entire link plate area is continuously shaded.
en.fix: If you trim the wrong arc, press Ctrl+Z. Do not leave internal arcs that divide the region into additional unspecified contours.

steps.title: 将连接板拉伸 6 mm
steps.command: 退出草图 → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 6
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。设给定深度 6，方向向上（h=0 到 6）。
检查外形是两端圆弧之间的渐缩连接板，点击绿色对勾。
steps.check: 板底在 Top Plane，板顶 h=6。
steps.fix: 这里的 6 是侧视图的板厚，与大端径向壁厚是两个独立标注。

en.title: Extrude the link plate by 6 mm
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Set Blind depth to 6 and extrude upward, from h=0 to 6.
Check that the preview is a tapering plate between the two end arcs, then click the green check mark.
en.check: The plate bottom lies on Top Plane and its top is at h=6.
en.fix: This 6 is the plate thickness in the side view. It is a separate dimension from the large-end radial wall thickness.

steps.title: 在板顶画同心 Ø32
steps.command: 选 h=6 顶面 → Sketch → Circle
actions: 选连接板顶面 → 草图 → Ctrl+8。在大端画一个圆。
Ctrl 选新圆与大端外圆弧 → 添加“同心 / Concentric”；智能尺寸设 Ø32。
若自动捕捉已使圆心锁在原点投影上，不必再加重复的同心关系；确认完全定义。
steps.check: 圆位于板的大端，和现有大端外弧同半径。
steps.fix: 不能选 Ø20；Ø20 是后续通孔。

en.title: Draw a concentric Ø32 circle on the plate top
en.command: Select the top face at h=6 → Sketch → Circle
actions: Select the link plate top face → Sketch → Ctrl+8. Draw a circle at the large end.
Ctrl-select the new circle and the large-end outer arc → add a Concentric relation. Set Ø32 with Smart Dimension.
If automatic inference has already locked the center to the projected origin, do not add a duplicate Concentric relation. Confirm that the sketch is fully defined.
en.check: The circle is at the large end of the plate and has the same radius as the existing large-end outer arc.
en.fix: Do not use Ø20 here; Ø20 is the later through hole.

steps.title: 追加 8，总高才是 14
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 8 → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。深度输入 8=14−6，方向向上。
勾选合并结果，确认大端从 h=0 到 h=14。
steps.check: 大端顶面比连接板顶面高 8。
steps.fix: 若在板顶再拉伸 14，大端总高会变成 20。

en.title: Add 8 to obtain a total height of 14
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Enter depth 8=14−6 and extrude upward.
Enable Merge result and confirm that the large end extends from h=0 to h=14.
en.check: The large-end top face is 8 above the link plate top face.
en.fix: Extruding another 14 from the plate top would make the large-end total height 20.

steps.title: 回到 Top Plane 画小端圆
steps.command: 在树中选 Top Plane → Sketch → Circle
actions: 不要选连接板顶面；在树中选原始 Top Plane（h=0），进入草图。
以小端圆心 (u,v)=(38,0) 画圆，设直径 18。
用同心关系与小端外圆弧定位；也可用圆心与原点水平、中心距 38 定位。确认完全定义。
steps.check: 草图在连接板底面所在的原始基准面。
steps.fix: 从板顶向下拉伸 24 会使底部变成 −18，少了 6。

en.title: Return to Top Plane and sketch the small-end circle
en.command: Select Top Plane in the tree → Sketch → Circle
actions: Do not select the link plate top face. Select the original Top Plane (h=0) in the tree and start a sketch.
Draw a circle at the small-end center (u,v)=(38,0) and set its diameter to 18.

Locate it using a Concentric relation to the small-end outer arc. Alternatively, make its center Horizontal with the origin and set the center distance to 38. Confirm that the sketch is fully defined.
en.check: The sketch lies on the original reference plane containing the plate bottom.
en.fix: Extruding downward by 24 from the plate top would put the bottom at −18, making it 6 too short.

steps.title: 反向拉伸 24 mm
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 24 → Reverse Direction
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。深度输入 24。
点击反向，使黄色预览向板下方（h=0 到 −24），合并结果，点击对勾。
steps.check: 小端下柱底面 h=−24，顶部仍为板顶 h=6。
steps.fix: 新增凸台与板底面整面接触，合并后应只有一个实体。

en.title: Reverse the extrusion and extend it by 24 mm
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Enter depth 24.
Click Reverse Direction so that the yellow preview extends below the plate, from h=0 to −24. Enable Merge result and click the check mark.
en.check: The lower boss bottom is at h=−24; its top remains at the plate top, h=6.
en.fix: The new boss contacts the plate bottom over its full end face. After merging, there should be only one solid body.

steps.title: 大端画 Ø20 并贯穿
steps.command: 选大端顶面 → Sketch → Circle → Extruded Cut
actions: 选大端 h=14 顶面，进入草图。在大端中心画圆；以同心关系定位，设 Ø20。
确认草图完全定义，退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部。
箭头朝下切入实体；确认后可看到穿过大端和连接板的通孔。
steps.check: 大端保留径向 6 mm 壁厚。
steps.fix: 此步先单独切大孔；不要在两个不同高度的端面上混画一个平面草图。

en.title: Draw Ø20 at the large end and cut it through
en.command: Select the large-end top face → Sketch → Circle → Extruded Cut
actions: Select the large-end top face at h=14 and start a sketch. Draw a circle at the large-end center, locate it with a Concentric relation, and set Ø20.
Confirm that the sketch is fully defined, then Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All.
Point the arrow downward into the solid. After confirmation, the hole should pass through both the large end and the link plate.
dimensions: 14 mm (use Through All as the end condition)
en.check: A radial wall thickness of 6 mm remains at the large end.
en.fix: Cut the large hole separately in this step. Do not try to draw one planar sketch on two end faces at different heights.

steps.title: 小端画 Ø6 并贯穿整根柱
steps.command: 选小端 h=6 顶面 → Sketch → Circle → Through All
actions: 选连接板的小端顶面 h=6，画与小端同心的 Ø6 圆，完全定义。
退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部，方向向下，穿过板和下圆柱。
点击绿色对勾，检查两个孔都已贯穿。
steps.check: 小孔在下圆柱底面有出口。
steps.fix: 不能只切连接板的 6 mm。

en.title: Draw Ø6 at the small end and cut through the whole boss
en.command: Select the small-end top face at h=6 → Sketch → Circle → Through All
actions: Select the small-end top face of the plate at h=6. Draw a Ø6 circle concentric with the small end and fully define it.
Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All. Cut downward through both the plate and the lower boss.
Click the green check mark and verify that both holes pass completely through.
en.check: The small hole has an exit on the lower boss bottom face.
en.fix: Do not cut only the plate's 6 mm thickness.

steps.title: 检查对称、两孔与体积
steps.command: Ctrl+Q → Evaluate → Mass Properties → Ctrl+S
actions: 检查两圆心都在 v=0，中心距 38；大端总高 14、小端最低点 −24、板厚 6。
体积目标 16268 mm³ ±1%，本教程几何约 16267.9151 mm³。
最终设计树：3 个拉伸凸台、2 个拉伸切除。各草图完全定义，保存 Q2.sldprt。
steps.check: Front Plane 是整个零件的对称面，体积在范围内。
steps.fix: 本题不需要镜像实体，也不需要孔向导来获得这些简单通孔。

en.title: Check symmetry, both holes, and volume
actions: Check that both centers lie at v=0 with center distance 38; the large-end total height is 14, the small-end lowest point is −24, and the plate thickness is 6.
The target volume is 16268 mm³ ±1%. The geometry in this tutorial is approximately 16267.9151 mm³.
The final design tree should contain 3 boss extrusions and 2 extruded cuts. Fully define every sketch and save Q2.sldprt.
en.check: Front Plane is the symmetry plane of the entire part, and the volume is within the acceptable range.
en.fix: Neither Mirror nor Hole Wizard is needed to create these simple through holes.

steps.title: 新建 Q3，把原点放在底边中点
steps.command: Ctrl+N → Part → MMGS → 保存 Q3.sldprt
actions: 新建零件，单位 MMGS。以底板前端底边中点（原图粉点）为原点。
本题 u 为前后长度 35，v 为左右宽度 52，h 为高度；Front Plane（v=0）是左右对称面。
steps.check: 原点不是底板的某个角，也不是底板中心。
steps.fix: 本题图上的 52 是总宽，35 是前后总长。

en.title: Create Q3 with the origin at the bottom-edge midpoint
actions: Create a new part with MMGS units. Place the origin at the midpoint of the front bottom edge of the base, shown by the pink point in the source drawing.
For this question, u is the front-to-back length 35, v is the left-to-right width 52, and h is height. Front Plane (v=0) is the left-to-right symmetry plane.
en.check: The origin is neither a base corner nor the center of the base.
en.fix: In this drawing, 52 is the total width and 35 is the total front-to-back length.

steps.title: 在 Top Plane 画 35 × 52
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Corner Rectangle → Smart Dimension
actions: Top Plane → 草图 → Ctrl+8。先画矩形，长方向沿 u、宽方向沿 v。
智能尺寸设长 35、宽 52。选前短边的中点和原点 → 重合；可右键该边选择“选择中点 / Select Midpoint”。
确认矩形从 u=0 向 u=35，宽度两侧各 26，草图完全定义。
steps.check: 原点在前边中间，矩形宽度关于 Front Plane 对称。
steps.fix: 不要使用以原点为中心的中心矩形；那会把前端放到 u=−17.5。

en.title: Sketch a 35 × 52 rectangle on Top Plane
en.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Corner Rectangle → Smart Dimension
actions: Top Plane → Sketch → Ctrl+8. Draw a rectangle with its length along u and width along v.
Use Smart Dimension to set length 35 and width 52. Select the front short edge midpoint and the origin → Coincident. You can right-click the edge and choose Select Midpoint.
Confirm that the rectangle extends from u=0 to u=35, with 26 on each side across its width, and that the sketch is fully defined.
en.check: The origin lies at the front-edge midpoint, and the rectangle width is symmetric about Front Plane.
en.fix: Do not use a Center Rectangle centered at the origin; that would place the front end at u=−17.5.

steps.title: 拉伸底板厚 7
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 7
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体 → 给定深度 7，方向向上。
点击绿色对勾。此阶段暂时是四角方形底板。
steps.check: 底板底面 h=0，顶面 h=7。
steps.fix: 下一步只处理前端两个角。

en.title: Extrude the base to thickness 7
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind depth 7, directed upward.
Click the green check mark. At this stage, the rectangular base still has four square corners.
en.check: The base bottom is at h=0 and the top is at h=7.
en.fix: The next step modifies only the two front corners.

steps.title: 只选前端两条竖边，做 R10
steps.command: Features → 圆角 Fillet → 半径 Radius 10
actions: 按空格选择等轴测；按 Ctrl 多选 u=0 前端左右两条竖直棱，它们均从 h=0 延伸到 7。
点击“特征 → 圆角 / Fillet”，设半径 10，检查预览只有前端两角变圆。
若预览选择扩大，关闭“切线延伸 / Tangent propagation”并重新确认选择。点击对勾。
steps.check: 俯视时前端两角为 R10，后端两角仍直角。
steps.fix: 不能选底板整条上沿，也不能把四个角全圆。

en.title: Apply R10 to only the two front vertical edges
actions: Press Spacebar and select an isometric view. Ctrl-select the left and right front vertical edges at u=0; both extend from h=0 to 7.
Click Features → Fillet, set radius 10, and check that the preview rounds only the two front corners.
If the preview includes additional edges, turn off Tangent propagation and check the selection again. Click the check mark.
en.check: In top view, the two front corners have R10 fillets while the two rear corners remain square.
en.fix: Do not select the entire top perimeter of the base, and do not round all four corners.

steps.title: 在底板上定位 26 × 34 立台
steps.command: 选 h=7 顶面 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: 选底板顶面 → 草图 → Ctrl+8，画矩形。尺寸设 u 向长 26、v 向宽 34。
让后边与底板后边 u=35 共线：选后边的端点和底板后边添加重合/在边线上关系；再令该边中点在 Front Plane 的中线上。
也可直接把矩形后边中点与底板后边中点重合，再标 26 和 34。前端位置由 35−26=9 得到。
steps.check: 后面齐平，左右各距底板侧边 9。
steps.fix: 26 是前后长度，34 是横向宽度。

en.title: Locate the 26 × 34 upper body on the base
en.command: Select the top face at h=7 → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: Select the base top face → Sketch → Ctrl+8 and draw a rectangle. Set length 26 along u and width 34 along v.

Align its rear edge with the base rear edge at u=35: select a rear-edge endpoint and the base rear edge, and add a Coincident point-on-edge relation. Then place that edge's midpoint on the Front Plane centerline.
Alternatively, make the rectangle rear-edge midpoint Coincident with the base rear-edge midpoint, then dimension 26 and 34. The front position follows from 35−26=9.
en.check: The rear faces align, and there is 9 between the upper body and the base side edge on each side.
en.fix: 26 is the front-to-back length; 34 is the transverse width.

steps.title: 从底板顶面再拉伸 25
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 25 → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体 → 深度 25，向上，合并结果。
确认后立台顶面高度为 h=7+25=32。
steps.check: 上部实体为 26 × 34 × 25，且与底板合并。
steps.fix: 25 从底板顶面起算。

en.title: Extrude another 25 from the base top
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base → depth 25, directed upward, with Merge result enabled.
After confirmation, the upper-body top face is at h=7+25=32.
en.check: The upper solid is 26 × 34 × 25 and is merged with the base.
en.fix: 25 is measured from the base top face.

steps.title: 选两条根部凹边，做 R5
steps.command: Ctrl 选两条长根边 → Features → Fillet 5
actions: 选立台左右侧面与底板顶面相交的两条凹棱：v=±17、h=7，沿 u 从 9 到 35。
点击圆角，半径设 5。此处预览应在根部增加过渡材料；不是削去立台顶部的外圆角。
确认后再进行后开口切除，此时完整的长根边更容易选择。
steps.check: 立台左右侧根部有平滑 R5 过渡。
steps.fix: 若边线发亮的位置在顶部 h=32，说明选错边。

en.title: Apply R5 to the two concave root edges
en.command: Ctrl-select the two long root edges → Features → Fillet 5
actions: Select the two concave edges where the upper body's left and right side faces meet the base top: v=±17, h=7, extending along u from 9 to 35.
Click Fillet and set radius 5. The preview should add transition material at the roots; this is not an external fillet removing material from the upper-body top.
Confirm the fillets before cutting the rear opening, while the complete long root edges are easier to select.
en.check: There are smooth R5 transitions at the roots of both upper-body side faces.
en.fix: If the highlighted edge is at the top, h=32, you have selected the wrong edge.

steps.title: 在 Top Plane 画后开口矩形
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Corner Rectangle
actions: 在树中选 Top Plane（h=0），进入草图，Ctrl+8。
画矩形，横向关于 v=0 对称，宽 20（两侧 v=±10）。前边位置 u=16=35−19。
为避免后表面留下薄片，让矩形后边到 u=36，超出零件后端 1 mm；草图长度设 20。20 的草图长度包含这 1 mm 空切，实际零件开口深度仍是 19。
steps.check: 开口前边距底板前端 16，矩形后端超出后表面。
steps.fix: 草图的空切余量是本教程操作设定，不是原题额外尺寸。

en.title: Sketch the rear-opening rectangle on Top Plane
actions: Select Top Plane (h=0) in the tree, start a sketch, and press Ctrl+8.
Draw a rectangle symmetric across v=0 with width 20, so its sides are at v=±10. Set its front edge at u=16=35−19.

To avoid leaving a thin sliver at the rear face, extend the rectangle rear edge to u=36, which is 1 mm beyond the part rear. Set the sketch length to 20. This sketch length of 20 includes 1 mm outside the solid; the actual opening depth in the part remains 19.
en.check: The opening front edge is 16 from the base front, and the rectangle rear edge extends beyond the rear face.
en.fix: The sketch extension outside the solid is a construction choice in this tutorial, not an additional source-drawing dimension.

steps.title: 贯穿立台，也贯穿底板
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Through All - Both
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除。选“贯穿全部-两者 / Through All - Both”；若版本只有单向贯穿，选择向上的箭头。
确认预览从 h=0 穿过底板、立台直至顶面，点击对勾。
从底面看，中央后开口也能透过去。
steps.check: 底板后端中央形成开口，没有剩余的 7 mm 底板。
steps.fix: 只从立台顶面盲切 25 会留下错误底板。

en.title: Cut through both the upper body and the base
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut. Select Through All - Both. If your version only offers a single-direction through cut, point its arrow upward.
Check that the preview passes from h=0 through the base and upper body to the top, then click the check mark.
Look from the bottom: you should also be able to see through the central rear opening.
en.check: The center of the base rear is open, with no remaining 7 mm floor.
en.fix: A Blind cut of 25 from the upper-body top would leave an incorrect base floor.

steps.title: 在 Right Plane 画耳板轮廓
steps.command: Right Plane → Sketch → Line / Centerpoint Arc
actions: 选 Right Plane（u=0）→ 草图 → Ctrl+8。本草图用 (v,h) 描述。
用“圆心圆弧 / Centerpoint Arc”，圆心置于 (0,15)，从 (7.5,15) 绕上方到 (−7.5,15) 画上半圆；再画左竖边回到底边起点。
圆弧端点与竖线端点重合；两竖边与圆弧相切。底边水平、两侧竖直。
steps.check: 轮廓为宽 15、直边高 8、上接半圆的闭合耳形。
steps.fix: Right 草图的屏幕横向可能与 v 正向相反；本轮廓左右对称，用中线定位即可。

en.title: Sketch the lug profile on Right Plane
en.command: Right Plane → Sketch → Line / Centerpoint Arc
actions: Select Right Plane (u=0) → Sketch → Ctrl+8. This sketch is described using (v,h).
First draw the bottom edge from (−7.5,7) to (7.5,7), then the right vertical edge up to (7.5,15).
Use Centerpoint Arc with its center at (0,15). Draw the upper semicircle from (7.5,15), over the top, to (−7.5,15), then draw the left vertical edge back to the bottom-edge start point.
Make each arc endpoint Coincident with its vertical-line endpoint and make both vertical sides Tangent to the arc. The bottom edge is Horizontal and the two sides are Vertical.
en.check: The closed lug-shaped contour is 15 wide, with straight sides 8 high and an upper semicircle.
en.fix: The horizontal screen direction of a Right Plane sketch may be opposite to positive v. This profile is left-to-right symmetric, so locate it using the centerline.

steps.title: 把耳板草图完全定义
steps.command: Smart Dimension → R7.5 / 8 / 7；Add Relations
actions: 智能尺寸设顶弧半径 7.5；左或右直边长度 8；底边到原点的高度 7。
约束圆弧圆心与原点竖直对齐；两个弧端点同高，圆弧与竖边相切。检查是否已有对应自动关系，避免重复。
可添加从动尺寸核对总宽 15、弧心高 15、最高点 22.5。确认状态为完全定义。
steps.check: 耳板孔心基准将位于 h=15。
steps.fix: 原图的 8 定位圆心高于底板顶面的距离；不是整块耳板高度。

en.title: Fully define the lug sketch
actions: Use Smart Dimension to set the top-arc radius to 7.5, either straight-side length to 8, and the bottom-edge height above the origin to 7.

Constrain the arc center vertically above the origin, put the arc endpoints at the same height, and make the arc Tangent to the vertical sides. Check for existing inferred relations to avoid duplicates.
You may add Driven dimensions to check total width 15, arc-center height 15, and highest point 22.5. Confirm that the sketch status is Fully Defined.
en.check: The lug hole-center reference is at h=15.
en.fix: The source dimension 8 locates the center above the base top; it is not the full lug height.

steps.title: 沿长度正向拉伸耳板 5
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 5 → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体 → 给定深度 5。
看预览，耳板应从 u=0 向底板内部到 u=5。必要时点击反向；合并结果后确认。
steps.check: 耳板立在前端底板上，底部与底板合并。
steps.fix: 反方向会把耳板悬到 u<0，只在边界接触或无法合并。

en.title: Extrude the lug by 5 in the positive length direction
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind depth 5.
Check the preview: the lug should extend from u=0 inward over the base to u=5. Click Reverse Direction if necessary, then confirm with Merge result enabled.
en.check: The lug stands on the front of the base, and its bottom is merged with the base.
en.fix: The opposite direction would place the lug at u<0, leaving only boundary contact or preventing a successful merge.

steps.title: 在耳板外面定位 Ø6
steps.command: 选 u=0 耳板平面 → Sketch → Circle
actions: 选耳板前平面（u=0）→ 草图 → Ctrl+8。
画圆，设 Ø6；与耳板顶弧添加同心关系，使圆心 v=0、h=15。
确认完全定义。孔心到底板顶面为 8。
steps.check: 孔心位于顶弧圆心，而不是耳板总高度的一半。
steps.fix: 如果同心已确定圆心，不要再重复添加两个位置尺寸。

en.title: Locate Ø6 on the outer lug face
en.command: Select the lug face at u=0 → Sketch → Circle
actions: Select the lug front face (u=0) → Sketch → Ctrl+8.
Draw a circle and set Ø6. Add a Concentric relation to the lug top arc, placing the center at v=0, h=15.
Confirm that the sketch is fully defined. The hole center is 8 above the base top.
en.check: The hole center coincides with the top-arc center, rather than being halfway up the full lug height.
en.fix: If the Concentric relation already determines the center, do not add two redundant location dimensions.

steps.title: 贯穿耳板和后方前壁
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Through All → 朝 +u
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部，箭头指向 +u，即朝零件内部。
预览会同时切过 u=0…5 的耳板和 u=9…16 的立台前壁；后方已经是开口。
确认并旋转模型，观察立台前壁上的第二段孔。
dimensions: 耳板 5 mm + 前壁 7 mm
steps.check: 同一条孔轴穿过耳板和后方墙体。
steps.fix: 不能只输入切深 5；题目要求所有孔都贯穿全部。

en.title: Cut through the lug and the front wall behind it
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All, with the arrow pointing along +u, into the part.
The preview should cut both the lug at u=0…5 and the upper-body front wall at u=9…16; behind that wall, the opening already exists.
Confirm and rotate the model to inspect the second section of the hole through the upper-body front wall.
en.check: One common hole axis passes through both the lug and the wall behind it.
en.fix: Do not enter a cut depth of only 5. The question requires all holes to use Through All.

steps.title: 检查原点、两处开口与体积
steps.command: Ctrl+Q → Mass Properties → Ctrl+S
actions: 原点在前端底边中点；Front Plane 是对称面；底板前两角 R10、立台根部两侧 R5。
核对后开口贯穿底板，Ø6 贯穿耳板及后壁。总高 32，耳板最高点 22.5。
体积目标 23361 mm³ ±1%；本教程几何约 23361.0343 mm³。保存 Q3.sldprt。
dimensions: 3 凸台 + 2 圆角 + 2 切除
steps.check: 原点、方向和体积都正确。
steps.fix: 圆角/开口位置错误可能相互抵消体积，仍需按原图检查。

en.title: Check the origin, both openings, and volume
actions: Check that the origin is at the front bottom-edge midpoint, Front Plane is the symmetry plane, the base front corners are R10, and both upper-body root fillets are R5.
Verify that the rear opening passes through the base and that Ø6 passes through the lug and the wall behind it. The total height is 32 and the lug highest point is 22.5.
The target volume is 23361 mm³ ±1%; this tutorial's geometry is approximately 23361.0343 mm³. Save Q3.sldprt.
en.check: The origin, directions, and volume are all correct.
en.fix: Errors in fillet or opening locations can offset each other in the volume calculation. You must still check their positions against the source drawing.

steps.title: 新建 Q4，切换到英寸
steps.command: Ctrl+N → Part → IPS → 保存 Q4.sldprt
actions: 新建零件，单位改为 IPS。以下本题所有长度均为英寸；尺寸输入框也可直接键入带“in”的数值。
以开口内侧两条斜线交点为 (u,v)=(0,0)。侧视图红点位于上表面，因此 Top Plane 是 h=0，实体厚度向下到 h=−0.3。
Front Plane（v=0）是沿手柄长度的对称面。这里用三个简单凸台组成外形，再切两个孔口。
steps.check: IPS 已启用，原点在开口尖点所在的上表面。
steps.fix: 旧版查看器曾用厚度中面；本教程及本次更新的 Q4 STEP 统一改为原图上表面原点。

en.title: Create Q4 and switch to inches
actions: Create a new part and change the units to IPS. All lengths in this question are in inches; you can also type a value with an “in” suffix directly into a dimension input box.

Use the intersection of the two inclined edges inside the open jaw as (u,v)=(0,0). The red origin in the side view is on the upper surface, so Top Plane is h=0 and the solid extends downward to h=−0.3.
Front Plane (v=0) is the symmetry plane along the handle. Here, three simple bosses form the outside shape, followed by two cuts for the jaw and hole.
en.check: IPS is active, and the origin lies on the upper surface at the jaw apex.
en.fix: The old viewer used the thickness midplane. This tutorial and the updated Q4 STEP both use the upper-surface origin shown in the source drawing.

steps.title: 先算出两端外圆的圆心
steps.command: 本步读图与计算，不创建特征
actions: 左端截平线在 u=−0.4；从截平线到斜口起点为 0.25，所以斜口起点及左外圆心竖线在 u=−0.15。
外圆半径 0.4，手柄半宽 0.2。圆弧和柄边的水平投影差 a=√(0.4²−0.2²)=0.3464101615。
3.25 是两处颈部间的直边长度，不是两圆心距。后续计算值至少保留 8 位小数，或直接在尺寸框输入右侧表达式。
steps.check: 右端圆心没有直接设置为 3.25。
steps.fix: 这些坐标由标注推导；详图 2:1 是显示比例，不能把标注再乘 2。

en.title: Calculate the centers of both outer circles first
en.command: Read the drawing and calculate; no feature is created in this step
actions: The flat clipping line at the left end is u=−0.4. Its distance to the start of the inclined jaw edge is 0.25, so that start point and the vertical line through the left outer-circle center are at u=−0.15.
The outer radius is 0.4 and the handle half-width is 0.2. The horizontal offset from the arc center to the handle-edge intersection is a=√(0.4²−0.2²)=0.3464101615.
The left neck is u=−0.15+a=0.1964101615. The straight handle length between the necks is 3.25, so the right circle center is u=−0.15+2a+3.25=3.7928203230.

3.25 is the straight-edge length between the two necks, not the circle center distance. Keep at least 8 decimal places in the calculated values below, or enter the expression shown in the table directly into the dimension box.
en.check: The right circle-center position has not simply been set to 3.25.
en.fix: These coordinates are derived from the dimensions. The 2:1 detail scale is a display scale; do not multiply the stated dimensions by 2.

steps.title: 画左端 Ø0.8 外圆与截平线
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Circle / Line
actions: Top Plane → 草图 → Ctrl+8。以原点左侧 0.15、v=0 为圆心画圆；设直径 0.8。
圆心与原点水平，标水平距离 0.15。
画一条竖直直线穿过圆，位置 u=−0.4，向圆上下两侧稍微延长。设它到原点的水平距离 0.4。
steps.check: 截线在圆心左侧，离圆心 0.25。
steps.fix: 圆心不是原点；原点是后续开口的尖点。

en.title: Draw the left Ø0.8 outer circle and clipping line
actions: Select Top Plane → Sketch → Ctrl+8. Draw a circle centered 0.15 to the left of the origin, at v=0; set its diameter to 0.8.
Add a Horizontal relation between the circle center and the origin, and dimension their horizontal distance as 0.15.
Draw a vertical line through the circle at u=−0.4, extending slightly beyond the circle above and below. Set its horizontal distance from the origin to 0.4.
en.check: The clipping line is to the left of the circle center, at a distance of 0.25 from it.
en.fix: The circle center is not the origin; the origin is the apex of the jaw opening created later.

steps.title: 修剪成左端截平的圆头
steps.command: Trim Entities → Power Trim
actions: 修剪掉直线左侧的外圆小圆弧，并删去竖线超出圆的上下两段。
保留右侧大圆弧和两端接弧的竖直弦，形成一个闭合外轮廓。
重新核对弧半径 0.4、圆心 u=−0.15/v=0、竖线 u=−0.4，端点重合，草图完全定义。
steps.check: 轮廓左边平直，上下和右侧为圆弧。
steps.fix: 不要保留左侧小圆弓区域。

en.title: Trim the left head to a flat-ended circular outline
actions: Trim away the minor outer-circle arc to the left of the vertical line, and remove the line segments extending above and below the circle.
Keep the major arc on the right and the vertical chord joining its endpoints to form one closed outer profile.
Recheck the arc radius 0.4, center u=−0.15/v=0, and vertical line u=−0.4. Make the endpoints Coincident and fully define the sketch.
dimensions: The major portion on the right of the circle
en.check: The profile is flat on the left, with a circular arc around its upper, lower and right sides.
en.fix: Do not keep the small circular-segment region on the left.

steps.title: 向下拉伸 0.3 in
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 0.3in → Reverse Direction
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。结束条件选给定深度，输入 0.3in。
反向使实体在 Top Plane 下方（h=−0.3…0）；点击对勾。
steps.check: 原点在上表面；不是厚度中间。
steps.fix: 本题此处不要选 Mid Plane。

en.title: Extrude downward by 0.3 in
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Set the end condition to Blind and enter 0.3in.
Reverse the direction so the solid lies below Top Plane (h=−0.3…0), then click the check mark.
en.check: The origin is on the upper surface, not halfway through the thickness.
en.fix: Do not select Mid Plane here for this question.

steps.title: 画与左头重叠的矩形手柄
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Center Rectangle
actions: 回到 Top Plane，进入草图。用中心矩形：中心在 (u,v)=(1.8964101615,0)。
智能尺寸设长度 3.7928203230、宽度 0.4。中心与原点水平，并标中心水平距离 1.8964101615（右圆心距离的一半）。
矩形范围是 u=0…3.7928203230、v=±0.2；左侧与圆头重叠，重叠部分后续合并。
steps.check: 矩形左边通过原点，宽度两侧各 0.2。
steps.fix: 这里的矩形长度是构造尺寸；与圆头合并后的外露直边才是 3.25。

en.title: Draw a rectangular handle overlapping the left head
actions: Return to Top Plane and start a sketch. Use Center Rectangle with its center at (u,v)=(1.8964101615,0).
Use Smart Dimension to set length 3.7928203230 and width 0.4. Make the center Horizontal with the origin and dimension its horizontal distance as 1.8964101615, half the right circle-center position.
The rectangle spans u=0…3.7928203230 and v=±0.2. Its left portion overlaps the circular head; the overlapping material will merge in the next feature.
en.check: The left edge of the rectangle passes through the origin, with a half-width of 0.2 on each side.
en.fix: This rectangle length is a construction dimension. Only the exposed straight edge after merging with the circular heads is 3.25.

steps.title: 向下拉伸手柄并合并
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 0.3in → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体 → 给定深度 0.3in。
方向向下，与左头占据相同厚度区间；勾选合并结果，确认。
steps.check: 手柄与左头连成单个实体。
steps.fix: 若树中出现 2 个实体，检查方向与重叠位置。

en.title: Extrude the handle downward and merge it
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 0.3in.
Extrude downward through the same thickness interval as the left head. Select Merge result and confirm.
en.check: The handle and left head form a single solid body.
en.fix: If the tree shows 2 solid bodies, check the extrusion direction and overlap.

steps.title: 定位右端 R0.4 圆头
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Circle
actions: Top Plane 新建草图，在右端画圆。
圆心与原点水平，圆心水平距离输入 3.7928203230；直径输入 0.8。
确认完全定义。圆心应与手柄矩形右边中点重合。
steps.check: 圆头与手柄有足够重叠，不是只在单点接触。
steps.fix: 可以用端边中点重合替代圆心距离尺寸，两者不要重复约束。

en.title: Locate the right R0.4 circular head
actions: Start a new sketch on Top Plane and draw a circle at the right end.
Make its center Horizontal with the origin. Enter horizontal center distance 3.7928203230 and diameter 0.8.
Confirm that the sketch is Fully Defined. The circle center should coincide with the midpoint of the handle rectangle’s right edge.
en.check: The circular head overlaps the handle sufficiently; they do not touch at only one point.
en.fix: You may use a Coincident relation to the end-edge midpoint instead of the center-distance dimension. Do not apply both as redundant constraints.

steps.title: 拉伸右头并检查外露直边
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Blind 0.3in → Merge result
actions: 退出草图，向下拉伸 0.3in，合并结果。
在“评估 → 测量 / Measure”选择手柄一条外露直边，检查长度 3.25in。
测量结果可能显示换算后的 82.55mm，两者相同。
steps.check: 完整外轮廓已有两头和手柄，厚度一致。
steps.fix: 若直边是约 2.71in，通常把圆心距误设成了 3.25。

en.title: Extrude the right head and check the exposed straight edge
actions: Exit the sketch, extrude downward by 0.3in, and select Merge result.
Under Evaluate → Measure, select an exposed straight handle edge and check that its length is 3.25in.
The measurement may display the converted value of 82.55mm; these values are equivalent.
en.check: The complete outer shape contains both heads and the handle, all with the same thickness.
en.fix: If the straight edge is about 2.71in, the center distance was probably incorrectly set to 3.25.

steps.title: 画开口切除五边形
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Line
actions: 上下边水平、左边竖直；两斜边交点与原点重合。画一条通过原点的水平构造中心线，让上下两个斜口起点关于它对称，并令这两个起点竖直对齐。标上口高度 0.25、起点到原点水平距离 0.15；下口位置由对称关系确定。
左侧延到 u=−0.6 是为了超出原零件 u=−0.4，不影响实际开口；设左边到原点距离 0.6，完全定义草图。
steps.check: 开口尖点准确落在原点，两条斜线向左连接平行口。
steps.fix: 对称宽度可用一半 0.25 加对称关系；不要同时添加互相重复的 0.25、0.25、0.5。

en.title: Draw the five-sided jaw-cut profile
actions: Start a new sketch on Top Plane. Use connected lines to join (u,v)=(-0.6,-0.25), (-0.15,-0.25), (0,0), (-0.15,0.25), and (-0.6,0.25), in that order, then close the profile.

Make the upper and lower edges Horizontal and the left edge Vertical. Make the intersection of the inclined edges Coincident with the origin. Draw a horizontal construction centerline through the origin; make the upper and lower inclined-edge start points Symmetric about it and vertically aligned with each other. Dimension the upper opening height as 0.25 and the start point’s horizontal distance from the origin as 0.15. Symmetry determines the lower opening position.

Extending the left boundary to u=−0.6 takes the cut beyond the part edge at u=−0.4 without changing the actual jaw opening. Set the left boundary’s distance from the origin to 0.6 and fully define the sketch.
en.check: The jaw apex lies exactly at the origin, and both inclined edges extend leftward to the parallel opening edges.
en.fix: Use the half-width 0.25 together with symmetry. Do not add the redundant dimensions 0.25, 0.25 and 0.5 simultaneously.

steps.title: 将开口贯穿厚度
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Through All → 向下
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部。
预览朝下穿过 0.3in 厚度；确认后左头形成开口扳口。
steps.check: 开口上下平行边之间为 0.5in，尖点在原点。
steps.fix: 如果未切除材料，反向箭头，使切除向 Top Plane 下方。

en.title: Cut the jaw through the thickness
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All.
The preview should cut downward through the 0.3in thickness. Confirm to form the open jaw in the left head.
en.check: The parallel upper and lower jaw edges are 0.5in apart, with their apex at the origin.
en.fix: If no material is removed, reverse the arrow so the cut extends below Top Plane.

steps.title: 画对边距 0.5 的正六边形
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → 多边形 Polygon → 边数 6
actions: 在 Top Plane 新建草图，点击“多边形 / Polygon”，边数设为 6，在右端圆心放置中心。
画出大致六边形后按 Esc，选上边加“水平”关系，使上下两边水平。中心与右端圆心重合，或中心 v=0、u=3.7928203230。
用智能尺寸选上下两条水平边，设它们的垂直距离为 0.5in；保留正多边形生成的等长关系，确认完全定义。
dimensions: 正六边形，水平对边距 0.5 in
steps.check: 上下是平边，左右是尖角；对边距 0.5。
steps.fix: 不要把 0.5 标成外接圆直径或顶点间距。

en.title: Draw a regular hexagon with 0.5 across flats
en.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Polygon → Number of sides: 6
actions: Start a new sketch on Top Plane. Click Polygon, set the number of sides to 6, and place its center at the right head’s circle center.

After drawing an approximate hexagon, press Esc. Select its top edge and add a Horizontal relation so the top and bottom edges are horizontal. Make the polygon center Coincident with the right circle center, or locate it at v=0 and u=3.7928203230.

Use Smart Dimension to select the upper and lower horizontal edges and set their vertical separation to 0.5in. Keep the equal-length relations generated by the regular polygon tool, and confirm that the sketch is Fully Defined.
dimensions: Regular hexagon; horizontal across-flats size 0.5 in
en.check: The top and bottom are flat sides, and the left and right ends are vertices. The across-flats size is 0.5.
en.fix: Do not dimension 0.5 as the circumcircle diameter or the distance between opposite vertices.

steps.title: 贯穿切出六角孔
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Through All
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部，向下穿过右圆头。
确认并检查背面同样有六角孔出口。
steps.check: 六角孔完全贯穿，右头外侧为 R0.4。
steps.fix: 没有额外的倒角或圆角要求，不添加未给出的形状。

en.title: Cut the hexagonal hole through all
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All, cutting downward through the right circular head.
Confirm and check that the hexagonal opening also exits on the reverse side.
en.check: The hexagonal hole passes completely through the head, whose outside radius is R0.4.
en.fix: No additional chamfers or fillets are specified. Do not add shapes absent from the drawing.

steps.title: 按 in³ 检查体积和上表面原点
steps.command: Ctrl+Q → Mass Properties → 输出单位 in³ → Ctrl+S
actions: 核对柄宽 0.4、厚 0.3、外露直边长 3.25、开口宽 0.5、六角对边距 0.5。
确认原点在上表面开口尖点，Front Plane 是宽度方向对称面。
参考体积 0.5492in³ ±1%；本教程几何约 0.54962156in³，偏差约 +0.077%。保存 Q4.sldprt。
steps.check: 报告以 in³ 显示，体积和原点均正确。
steps.fix: 如果显示约 0.5496mm³，尺寸很可能误按毫米输入；需修改尺寸，不能只改报告单位。

en.title: Check the volume in in³ and the upper-surface origin
en.command: Ctrl+Q → Mass Properties → Output units: in³ → Ctrl+S
actions: Check handle width 0.4, thickness 0.3, exposed straight-edge length 3.25, jaw opening 0.5, and hexagon across-flats size 0.5.
Confirm that the origin is at the jaw apex on the upper surface, and that Front Plane is the symmetry plane across the width.
The reference volume is 0.5492in³ ±1%. This tutorial geometry is approximately 0.54962156in³, a difference of about +0.077%. Save Q4.sldprt.
en.check: The report displays in³, and both the volume and origin are correct.
en.fix: If the report shows about 0.5496mm³, the dimensions were probably entered as millimeters. Correct the dimensions rather than changing only the report units.

steps.title: 新建 Q5，使用教学近似尺寸
steps.command: Ctrl+N → Part → MMGS → 保存 Q5.sldprt
actions: 本题引用 Lab 3 第4题；本次附件没有该页。本网站保留原 Lab4 网站已有的 Lab3 原图与近似模型，供继续跟做。
原题没有精确尺寸。下面所有数值都是本教程沿用的近似设定，用于完全定义示例，不是唯一标准答案。
新建零件，MMGS，保存 Q5.sldprt。Front Plane（v=0）为最终对称面；实体特征仅使用拉伸凸台与拉伸切除。
dimensions: 近似总长 / 深度 / 主体高
steps.check: 清楚这些数值是教学选择，最终只使用允许的两类实体特征。
steps.fix: 不要把 Q3 的“所有孔贯穿”要求套到 Q5 的盲孔。

en.title: Create Q5 using chosen approximate teaching dimensions
actions: This question refers to Lab 3 Question 4, whose page is not included in the current attachment. This website retains the original Lab4 website’s existing Lab3 source figure and approximate model so you can continue following along.
The original question gives no exact dimensions. All values below are chosen approximate dimensions retained for this tutorial to fully define the example; they are not a unique standard answer.
Create a new part, use MMGS, and save Q5.sldprt. Front Plane (v=0) is the final symmetry plane. Use only Extruded Boss/Base and Extruded Cut for solid features.
dimensions: Approximate overall length / depth / main height
en.check: Understand that these values are teaching choices, and use only the two permitted types of solid feature.
en.fix: Do not apply Q3’s “all holes Through All” requirement to the blind bores in Q5.

steps.title: 在 Front Plane 画五边形
steps.command: Front Plane → Sketch → Line
actions: Front Plane → 草图 → Ctrl+8。本面用 (u,h) 表示坐标。
先画近似轮廓，按 Esc；P2—P3 和 P4—P5 水平，P3—P4 竖直，各相邻端点重合。
steps.check: 左端是尖点，右端是竖边的闭合五边形。
steps.fix: 原点在左尖点正下方的底面基准，尖点本身比原点高 20。

en.title: Draw the pentagonal profile on Front Plane
actions: Select Front Plane → Sketch → Ctrl+8. Coordinates on this plane are written as (u,h).
Use connected lines to click P1=(0,20), P2=(12,0), P3=(60,0), P4=(60,40), and P5=(12,40), in that order, then return to P1.
Draw an approximate profile first, then press Esc. Make P2—P3 and P4—P5 Horizontal, P3—P4 Vertical, and each pair of adjacent endpoints Coincident.
en.check: The closed pentagon has an apex at the left end and a vertical edge at the right end.
en.fix: The origin is on the bottom datum directly below the left apex; the apex itself is 20 above the origin.

steps.title: 用 4 个尺寸与对齐关系定义轮廓
steps.command: Smart Dimension → 20 / 12 / 60 / 40
actions: Ctrl 选 P1 与原点 → 竖直；标 P1 高度 20。Ctrl 选 P2 与原点 → 水平；标 P2 水平位置 12。
标 P3 到原点的水平距离 60，以及右竖边高度 40。
Ctrl 选 P2、P5 → 竖直，使上下斜边转角的 u 都为 12。检查所有端点重合与边的水平/竖直关系，状态完全定义。
steps.check: 完全定义的五边形与给出的五个近似点一致。
steps.fix: 不要同时给每段斜边角度和长度，再重复标这些顶点位置。

en.title: Define the profile with 4 dimensions and alignment relations
actions: Ctrl-select P1 and the origin → Vertical; dimension P1’s height as 20. Ctrl-select P2 and the origin → Horizontal; dimension P2’s horizontal position as 12.
Dimension P3’s horizontal distance from the origin as 60, and the right vertical edge’s height as 40.
Ctrl-select P2 and P5 → Vertical, giving both upper and lower slope corners u=12. Check all Coincident endpoints and Horizontal/Vertical edge relations until the sketch is Fully Defined.
en.check: The fully defined pentagon matches the five given approximate points.
en.fix: Do not dimension every inclined edge’s angle and length and then redundantly dimension the same vertex positions.

steps.title: 中面拉伸，总深 48
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Mid Plane 48
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体。结束条件选“中面 / Mid Plane”，输入总深 48。
确认两侧各延伸 24，点击绿色对勾。
steps.check: 主体关于 Front Plane 对称。
steps.fix: 中面的 48 是两侧合计，不是每侧 48。

en.title: Extrude Mid Plane with a total depth of 48
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base. Set the end condition to Mid Plane and enter total depth 48.
Confirm that the extrusion extends 24 on each side, then click the green check mark.
en.check: The main body is symmetric about Front Plane.
en.fix: The Mid Plane value 48 is the combined depth on both sides, not 48 on each side.

steps.title: 在同一 Front Plane 画三角形
steps.command: Front Plane → Sketch → Line
actions: 在树中选 Front Plane，新建草图，依次连接 (u,h)=(0,20)、(8,47)、(8,20)，闭合。
底边水平、右边竖直；左下点与主体左尖点重合。设底边长 8、右竖边高 27=47−20。
确认完全定义。三角形下部与主体截面重叠，用于让新增实体合并。
steps.check: 三角尖峰位于 u=8、h=47。
steps.fix: 不要把峰高 47 输入为三角形的竖边长度。

en.title: Draw a triangle on the same Front Plane
actions: Select Front Plane in the tree and start a new sketch. Join (u,h)=(0,20), (8,47), and (8,20), in that order, and close the triangle.

Make the bottom edge Horizontal and the right edge Vertical. Make the lower-left vertex Coincident with the main body’s left apex. Set the bottom edge length to 8 and the right vertical edge height to 27=47−20.
Confirm that the sketch is Fully Defined. The lower portion of the triangle overlaps the main-body section so the added solid can merge with it.
en.check: The triangular peak is at u=8, h=47.
en.fix: Do not enter the overall peak height 47 as the length of the triangle’s vertical edge.

steps.title: 用普通凸台，中面总深 20
steps.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Mid Plane 20 → Merge result
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸凸台/基体 → 中面，总深 20。
勾选合并结果，确认 v=−10…10，中央凸起与主体合并。
steps.check: 凸起在深度中央，最高点 47。
steps.fix: 不用“筋 / Rib”或镜像特征；本题限制实体特征类型。

en.title: Use a regular boss with Mid Plane total depth 20
en.command: Extruded Boss/Base → Mid Plane 20 → Merge result
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Boss/Base → Mid Plane, total depth 20.
Select Merge result. Confirm the interval v=−10…10 and merge the central rise with the main body.
en.check: The rise is centered across the depth, with its highest point at 47.
en.fix: Do not use Rib or a Mirror feature; this question restricts the solid feature types.

steps.title: 在 Top Plane 画 48 × 36 开口
steps.command: Top Plane → Sketch → Center Rectangle
actions: 在树中选 Top Plane（h=0），新建草图并按 Ctrl+8。
用中心矩形，中心置于 (u,v)=(32,0)。设 u 向长度 48、v 向宽度 36。
中心与原点水平，标中心水平位置 32；矩形范围因此为 u=8…56、v=−18…18，完全定义。
steps.check: 左右两侧壁的厚度将为 6，右端壁厚为 4。
steps.fix: 该矩形要从底部一直开到顶部，不是浅凹槽。

en.title: Draw the 48 × 36 opening on Top Plane
actions: Select Top Plane (h=0) in the tree, start a new sketch, and press Ctrl+8.
Use Center Rectangle with center (u,v)=(32,0). Set the length along u to 48 and the width along v to 36.
Make the center Horizontal with the origin and dimension its horizontal position as 32. The rectangle therefore spans u=8…56 and v=−18…18. Fully define the sketch.
en.check: The two side walls will each be 6 thick, and the right end wall will be 4 thick.
en.fix: This rectangle must open all the way from the bottom to the top; it is not a shallow recess.

steps.title: 沿高度贯穿开口
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Through All - Both
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 贯穿全部-两者；也可选择单向向上贯穿。
预览切穿所有高度，确认后从底面检查没有残余底板。
steps.check: 中央开口穿透上下，中央凸起仍保留在左端。
steps.fix: 切除后应仍是连通的单一实体。

en.title: Cut the opening through the full height
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Through All - Both. Alternatively, use a one-direction Through All cut pointing upward.
Preview the cut through the full height. After confirming, inspect the underside to ensure no bottom plate remains.
en.check: The central opening passes through the top and bottom, while the central rise remains at the left end.
en.fix: The cut must leave one connected solid body.

steps.title: 在 v=−24 外侧面定位 Ø20
steps.command: 选一侧大外平面 → Sketch → Circle
actions: 旋转模型，选 v=−24 的大外平面（与 Front Plane 平行）。新建草图，Ctrl+8。
画圆，设 Ø20。标圆心到底边距离 20、到右竖边距离 20，使圆心 u=60−20=40、h=20。
确认完全定义。此面沿反方向查看时，屏幕左右可能反转，以“距右端实体边 20”定位。
steps.check: 圆位于大侧面中部偏右，距底边 20。
steps.fix: 不能把圆画在中间的空腔面或内壁上。

en.title: On the outside face at v=−24, locate the Ø20 bore
en.command: Select one large outside planar face → Sketch → Circle
actions: Rotate the model and select the large outside planar face at v=−24, parallel to Front Plane. Start a new sketch and press Ctrl+8.
Draw a circle and set Ø20. Dimension the center 20 from the bottom edge and 20 from the right vertical edge, giving center u=60−20=40, h=20.
Confirm that the sketch is Fully Defined. Viewing this face from the opposite direction may reverse screen left and right; locate the center by its distance of 20 from the part’s right-end edge.
en.check: The circle is slightly right of the middle of the large side face, with its center 20 from the bottom edge.
en.fix: Do not sketch the circle on an internal cavity face or inner wall.

steps.title: 只向内盲切 4 mm
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Blind 4
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除。结束条件选“给定深度 / Blind”，输入 4。
箭头朝零件内部，从 v=−24 到 −20；确认后孔底与内腔 v=−18 之间还剩 2 mm。
steps.check: 能看到孔底，孔不与中央开口连通。
steps.fix: 此时只做了一侧盲孔，零件暂未恢复最终对称。

en.title: Make only a 4 mm inward blind cut
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut. Select the Blind end condition and enter 4.
Point the arrow inward, from v=−24 to −20. After confirming, the gap between the bore bottom and the cavity at v=−18 retains 2 mm of material.
en.check: The bore has a visible bottom and does not open into the central cavity.
en.fix: Only one blind bore has been made at this stage, so the part has not yet regained its final symmetry.

steps.title: 在相反外侧面再画同样的圆
steps.command: 选 v=+24 外平面 → Sketch → Circle
actions: 旋转到相反一侧，选 v=+24 的外平面，新建草图。
再画 Ø20 圆，圆心同样距底边 20、距实体右端边 20，即 u=40、h=20。
确认完全定义。使用独立草图和拉伸切除，不使用镜像实体特征。
steps.check: 两侧圆沿深度方向同轴。
steps.fix: 不要因为视图翻转而把第二个孔定位到 u=20。

en.title: Draw the same circle on the opposite outside face
en.command: Select the outside face at v=+24 → Sketch → Circle
actions: Rotate to the opposite side, select the outside planar face at v=+24, and start a new sketch.
Draw another Ø20 circle. Again locate its center 20 from the bottom edge and 20 from the part’s right-end edge, giving u=40, h=20.
Confirm that the sketch is Fully Defined. Use a separate sketch and Extruded Cut, rather than a Mirror solid feature.
en.check: The two side circles are coaxial along the depth direction.
en.fix: Do not position the second bore at u=20 because the view has reversed.

steps.title: 第二侧也向内盲切 4
steps.command: Extruded Cut → Blind 4 → Reverse Direction（按预览）
actions: 退出草图 → 拉伸切除 → 给定深度 4。
方向朝内部，从 v=+24 到 +20；点击对勾。
两侧壁各厚 6，两个孔底各剩 2。
steps.check: 零件最终关于 Front Plane 对称，两孔都有盲孔底。
steps.fix: 不要选贯穿全部；两个孔底是投影解释的一部分。

en.title: Blind-cut the second side inward by 4 as well
en.command: Extruded Cut → Blind 4 → Reverse Direction (as required by the preview)
actions: Exit Sketch → Extruded Cut → Blind 4.
Cut inward, from v=+24 to +20, and click the check mark.
Each side wall is 6 thick, and each bore retains a bottom thickness of 2.
en.check: The finished part is symmetric about Front Plane, and both bores have blind bottoms.
en.fix: Do not select Through All; the retained bottoms are part of the projection interpretation.

steps.title: 按外形与特征类型完成检查
steps.command: Ctrl+Q → 前视 Front / 俯视 Top → Ctrl+S
actions: 核对五边形侧轮廓、左端中央三角凸起、上下贯穿的矩形开口，以及两侧带底的盲孔。
在树中检查实体特征仅有 2 个拉伸凸台和 3 个拉伸切除，没有筋、圆角或镜像特征；每张草图完全定义，实体数为 1。
本例体积约 34100.0592mm³，仅作复现此近似模型的检查，不是题目给定的体积目标。保存 Q5.sldprt。
steps.check: 外形相似、最终对称、孔底保留且只用了允许的实体特征。
steps.fix: 原题允许合理近似；不要通过量取原图像素来寻找所谓唯一精确尺寸。

en.title: Complete the shape and feature-type checks
actions: Check the pentagonal side profile, the central triangular rise at the left end, the rectangular opening through the top and bottom, and the blind bores with retained bottoms on both sides.

In the tree, confirm that the only solid features are 2 Extruded Boss/Base features and 3 Extruded Cut features, with no Rib, Fillet or Mirror feature. Fully define every sketch and confirm 1 solid body.
The example volume is approximately 34100.0592mm³. This is only a check for reproducing this approximate model, not a volume target given in the question. Save Q5.sldprt.
en.check: The shape is similar, final symmetry is restored, both bore bottoms remain, and only the permitted solid feature types are used.
en.fix: The original question allows reasonable approximations. Do not measure source-image pixels to seek a supposedly unique set of exact dimensions.
